summary: Maps a three-valued input to the next value in a cycle: 0 -> 1, 1 -> 2, 2 -> 0. Any other input returns -1 as an invalid sentinel. Called from AI session-mode transition, consistent with rotating an AI/session state machine through three modes.
unresolved: The three underlying enum meanings are unknown; the cyclic rotation is clear but the domain is not.
Relation of the mapping to AI session-mode semantics is unproven.
Whether -1 is consumed as an error or a no-op by the caller is not established.
